name: Transparent Girl
source:
Maricel is a 21 year old girl who's been mourning the loss of her childhood best friend for three years. Grief has overtaken her, and she can't bring herself to go on any longer. 

A tiny visual novel about the beauty and horror of a girl's last moment alive.

[From [url=https://dotvaria.itch.io/transparent-girl]itch.io[/url]]
